ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the schematic map of the distribution range of the subarctic coniferous forest belt. <image1> What is the dominant factor causing the difference in distribution latitude of the subarctic coniferous forest on the east and west coasts of the continent?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The schematic map marks the distribution range of the subarctic coniferous forest belt. This forest belt is close to a higher-latitude position on one side of the continent, while on the other side it extends to a lower-latitude position, showing that the distribution latitudes on the east and west coasts of the continent are inconsistent. Reasoning: The difference in solar radiation received by the east and west coasts of the continent at the same latitude is not large. If there is an obvious difference in coastal thermal conditions, it is usually related to coastal cold currents and warm currents. Warm currents have a warming effect and can make the coniferous forest belt extend to higher latitudes; cold currents have a cooling effect and can make it extend to lower latitudes. Therefore, the dominant factor causing this latitude difference is ocean currents.

method.method_draft: 读取图中亚寒带针叶林带在大陆东西两岸的南北位置差异：一岸分布纬度较高，另一岸分布纬度较低。再联系自然带分布的热量控制规律：同纬度大陆东西岸接受太阳辐射差别不大，若沿岸温度出现明显差异，通常由寒暖流影响。暖流增温使针叶林带向高纬延伸，寒流降温使其向低纬延伸，所以主导因素判定为洋流。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：示意图中标出了亚寒带针叶林带的分布范围，该林带在大陆一侧接近较高纬度位置，另一侧则延伸到较低纬度位置，表现为大陆东西两岸分布纬度不一致。推理：同纬度大陆东西两岸接受的太阳辐射差异不大，若沿岸热量条件出现明显差异，通常与沿岸寒流、暖流有关。暖流有增温作用，可使针叶林带向较高纬度延伸；寒流有降温作用，可使其向较低纬度延伸。因此导致这种纬度差异的主导因素是洋流。
